chunk.content: Sausage made from 100% Nibea albiflora received a reported texture score of 5.00 and taste score of 5.40; this describes the processed sausage.
chunk.source_quote: Sosis ikan gulamah 100% menghasilkan kenampakan (5,17%), aroma dan tekstur (5,00%), dan rasa (5,40%) dengan protein sebesar (6,67%)

source.title: Karakteristik Nilai Gizi dan Mutu Sensori Sosis Ikan Gulamah (Nibea albiflora) dengan Penambahan Daging Ayam
source.publisher: Jurnal IPTEKS Pemanfaatan Sumberdaya Perikanan, Universitas Hasanuddin
